besluite.fout: Once the comma marks a new main clause, the inverted 'en word hulle' reads stiff.
besluite.rede: Subject-verb order after the comma is the natural Afrikaans form, with the same actors, action and order.
The original already reads as two legs in order, so 'van daar' only makes the sentence longer.

besluite.fout: Bare verbs used as nouns after 'van' ('van gis en droog') read awkwardly.
besluite.rede: A short clause is clearer for a Grade 6 reader and adds nothing the lesson does not already say.
